# Velvet Ribbons

> Velvet Ribbons is a luxury gift wrapping and packaging studio in Whitby, Ontario, Canada, founded by Geetika and Nidhi. It hand-wraps gifts in rich papers, silk ribbons and signature bows, and creates corporate gifts and festive hampers for clients across Durham Region and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA).

## Key facts

- Business type: luxury gift wrapping studio (gift wrapping, gift hampers, corporate gifting)
- Location: Whitby, Ontario, Canada
- Service area: Whitby, Oshawa, Ajax, Pickering, Clarington and the rest of Durham Region, plus the Greater Toronto Area
- Founders: Geetika (co-founder, design) and Nidhi (co-founder, client care)
- Website: https://velvetribbons.ca/
- Email: hello@velvetribbons.ca
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/velvetribbons.ca
- Response time: replies to enquiries within one business day; corporate quotes within two business days

## Occasions

- Corporate gifting: client and employee gifts at volume, custom ribbon and tags in brand colours, holiday campaigns (Christmas, Diwali, year-end), event favours and launch kits, HST invoicing and scheduled office delivery
- Baby showers: soft palettes, keepsake boxes and delicate bows
- Birthdays: milestone and just-because gifts, wrapped to suit the person
- Christmas: velvet ribbon, gilded papers and coordinated family sets; December books up early
- Thanksgiving: harvest-toned host gifts, gratitude baskets and table favours
- Diwali: jewel tones, gold accents and festive trims for mithai boxes, hampers and gifts
- Housewarming: wraps for new-home gifts, from wine and candles to full welcome baskets

## How it works

1. Tell us the occasion and what you're gifting; we suggest papers, ribbons and finishes.
2. We wrap by hand: crisp folds, silk ribbon, signature bow, plus optional gift tags, wax seals or fresh trims.
3. Pick up from the Whitby studio, or get delivery anywhere in Durham Region and the GTA. Customers can also drop off gifts they have already bought.

## Booking

Use the enquiry form at https://velvetribbons.ca/#contact, email hello@velvetribbons.ca, or message Velvet Ribbons on Instagram.
